name: Dario Senn
bio: Senn quotes the articles of the Ironmuster Code before every deployment. He has become selective about which paragraphs he finishes.

personality.label: Doubtful idealist
personality.description: Knows every rule and increasingly questions its purpose. Formal on the radio, humane in a crisis.

move: Following the route. We can debate the wording later.
attack: I have read the order. Opening fire.
Let us keep this as brief as possible.
guard: Holding the line. The people behind it matter.
investigate: A return is not a verdict. I will confirm it.
heavy_fire: Taking sustained fire. I would appreciate an amendment to our position.
The regulation says seek cover. I find myself in agreement.
